rows.author: D089
rows.abstract: A STATEMENT ISSUED BY THE DOH CALLING FOR THE TOTAL BAN ON FIRECRACKERS AND PYROTECHNICS, HIGHLIGHTS THE LACK OF A CLEAR GOVERNMENT POLICY ON THE INDUSTRY.  THE TOTAL BAN ACTUALLY CONTRIBUTES TO THE EVER-GROWING NUMBER OF FATALITIES AND CASUALTIES USUALLY AS A KNEEJERK APPROACH TO SUCH CALLS BY THE DOH IS THE IMPOSITION OF UNREASONABLE CONDITIONS AND REQUIREMENTS UPON MANUFACTURERS AND DEALERS MANY OF WHOM GO UNDERGROUND SO THEY ARE DEVOID OF ANY REGULATION, THUS CONTRIBUTING TO THE RISKS OF THE INDUSTRY AND THE VULNERABILITY OF THE PUBLIC.  THE UNCLEAR AND CONFLICTING PRONOUNCEMENTS ON THE USE OF FIRECRACKERS AND PYROTECHNICS THUS BURDEN THE LEGITIMATED MANUFACTURERS, DEALERS AND USERS WHO ARE IN THE POSITION TO ASSIST THE GOVT. TO PREVENT THE DANGERS ASSOCIATED WITH IT.  STATES THAT R.A.7183 (FIRECRACKERS LAW) FAILED TO TAKE INTO ACCOUNT THE ECONOMIC CONTRIBUTIONS OF THE INDUSTRY AND THAT THERE IS A NEED TO VISIT, REVIEW AND REVISE OUR POLICIES REGARDING THE INDUSTRY.

rows.author: F035
rows.title_short: DEATH ANNIVERSARY OF KA POPOY LAGMAN
rows.abstract: INTRODUCED HIMSELF AS THE VOICE OF THE 2ND DISTRICT OF VALENZUELA CITY - DUBBED AS THE STRIKE CAPITAL OF THE PHILIPPINES.  REMINISHED THE LIFE, ORDEAL AND DEATH OF FILEMON \"KA POPOY\" LAGMAN WHO HE CLAIMED IS THE VOICE OF AN ADVOCATE AND CATALYST OF CHANGE MORE PARTICULARLY IN THE LABOR SECTOR.  RECALLED \"KA POPOY'S\" STEADFAST QUEST FOR SOCIAL CHANGE AND HIS UNWAVERING STAND ON ISSUES AND PROBLEMS THAT CONFRONTED THE WORKING CLASS AND THE NATION.  NARRATED THE BEGINNINGS OF HIS POLITICAL ACTIVISM WHICH LED THE FOUNDING OF THE BUKLURANG MANGGAGAWANG PILIPINO OR BMP AND THE FORMATION OF THE PARTIDO NG MAGGAGAWA(PM).  STATED THAT THE DEATH OF \"KA POPOY\" IS  NOT THE END OF HIS PRINCIPLES, HIS SPIRIT WILL LIVE ON AS LONG AS HIS LABOR ADVOCACY DOES NOT FIND FRUITION, AS LONG AS THERE ARE ABUSIVE CAPITALISTS AND DEPRIVED WORKERS, UNCARING GOVERNMENT LEADERS AND NEGLECTED CITIZENS, A SUPER RICH FEW AND IMPOVERSISHED MULTITUDES.  HIS ADVOCACY OF A LABOR PARTY THAT COULD REPRESENT THE WORKING CLASS IN THE LEGISLATURE PROVED THAT HE IS A MAN OF PEACE AND AN ADVOCATE OF INDUSTRIAL PEACE.  CALLS FOR THE ENACTMENT OF LAWS THAT WOULD ACCORD LABOR DIGNITY, RESPECT AND IMPORTANCE THAT IT RIGHTLY DESERVES AND ACCORD DUE JUSTICE TO THE LATE \"KA POPOY\" BY CONTINUING HIS FIGHT INSIDE AND OUTSIDE THE HALLS OF CONGRESS.

rows.author: F038
rows.abstract: BROUGHT TO THE ATTENTION OF THE BODY THE LATEST ATROCITY IN THE PROVINCE OF SULU, PARTICULARLY IN BGY. IPIL, MAIMBUNG.  PERSONALLY BELIEVED THAT THE BRUNT OF A WAR HAS ALREADY ENDED AFTER THE SIGNING OF THE PEACE AGREEMENT IN 1996, BUT UNFORTUNATE SKIRMISHES MAY TRIGGER A REPEAT OF THAT UGLY WAR.  LAMENTED HOW SUCH A WAR BROUGHT UNTOLD MISERIES ON THE PEOPLE OF SOUTHERN PHILS. AND HOW HE PERSONALLY EXPERIENCED THE CRUELTY, SAVAGERY, PAIN AND DESTRUCTION IT CARRIES IN ITS WAKE.  CALLS FOR A THOROUGH INVESTIGATION OF WHAT GOV. ABDULSAKUR TAN CALLED A MASSACRE WHICH GEN. RAFAEL REFERRED TO AS A LEGITIMATE OPERATION.  ENUMERATED THE NAMES AND AGES OF CASUALTIES AND DETAILED THEIR ORDEAL AND THE CAUSE OF THE SAVAGERY.  CITED THE MERITS OF HAVING THE PHILIPPINE ARMY WHICH HAS A SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF MORO NATIONAL LIBERATION FRONT (MILF) INTEGREES PRIMARILY SECURING THE JUNGLES AND SHORELINES OF SULU TO MINIMIZE CIVILIAN CASUALTIES IN THE PURSUIT OF PEACE.  REITERATED THE NEED TO CONDUCT A THOROUGH INVESTIGATION IN ORDER TO AVOID UNNECESSARY AND UNFORTUNATE DEATHS OF CIVILIANS AND DESTRUCTION OF PROPERTIES AND AVOID THE ESCALATION OF WAR AGAIN IN SOUTHERN PHILS.
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Rep. Ocampo.  Manifestations by Reps. Escudero, Solis, Alfelor, Ilagan, Climaco and Romualdo.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.title_short: VOTE BUYING IN THE SPEAKERSHIP ELECTION
rows.abstract: RELATED THAT HIS GRIEF ON THE DEATH OF SOME PEOPLE IN SULU IS MUCH OVER WITH THE APPARENT LOSS OF HONOR IN THE HOUSE DUE TO ALLEGED BUYING OF VOTES IN THE RECENT CHANGE FOR SPEAKERSHIP.  EXPRESSED HIS SENTIMENTS ON THE IMPORTANCE OF REGAINING THE HONOR OF THE HOUSE BY FIGHTING FOR THE TRUTH THAT THEY WERE NEVER BOUGHT.  HE ENDED HIS SPEECH BY SAYING THAT HE WANTED TO SET THE RECORD STRAIGHT THAT THE HOUSE IS NOT  HOUSE OF THIEVES OR A HOUSE OF REPRESENTATHIEVES BUT A HOUSE MADE OF REPRESENTATIVES.
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: D062
rows.abstract: DECLARED THAT THERE MUST BE SOME CHANGES WITH THE REPLACEMENT OF THE SPEAKER. STATED THAT HE IS AN ADVOCATE OF CHANGE AND THAT HE WAS AMONG THOSE WHO ORGANIZED THE REFORM BLOC AND ALL THE OTHER PARTIES.  EXPRESSED CONCERNS ON THE FF:  SECURITY AND DOCUMENTATION - DOCUMENTS TO BE TURNED OVER AND ALL THE LISTS THAT WERE SHREDDED IN THE OFFICE OF THE SPEAKER; THE STATE OF FUNDS OR A TOTAL DISCLOSURE OF FUNDS BY THE HOUSE BY DECEMBER 31, 2007; DISPARITY OF EMPLOYEES WELFARE VS THOSE IN THE SENATE; REORGANIZATION OR CHANGES IN POSITIONS; COMMITTEE CHAIRMANSHIP APPOINTMENT.  MOVED TO ORGANIZE ALL MEMBERS OF THE PARTY, TO ORGANIZE A TEAM - A KIND OF ADVISORY COMMITTEE THAT WOULD LOOK INTO WHAT HE SUGGESTED.
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Reps. Golez and Diaz.  Referred to the Committee on Rules.

rows.author: D001
rows.title_short: EFFECT OF THE CREATION OF NEW CITIES DURING THE 13TH CONGRESS
rows.abstract: EXPRESSED REGRET FOR A LACK OF POLITICAL WILL IN THE EXECUTION AND IMPLEMENTATION OF LAWS WHEN IT WOULD IMPUNGE OR THREATEN THE INTEREST OF THE LAWMAKERS, THEIR LOVED ONES OR CONSTITUENTS.  CITED TWO PROVISIONS OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT  CODE ON THE CREATION OF CITIES WHICH HE SAID WAS GRAVELY MISUNDERSTOOD AND MISTAKENLY IMPLEMENTED IN THE CREATION OF 16 CITIES DURING THE 13TH CONGRESS. MADE MENTION OF HIS ROLE IN THE DRAFTING OF ART. XI OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1971 AND 1973 CONSTITUTIONS FROM WHICH THE PRESENT ARTICLE X OF OUR NEW CONSTITUTION WAS LIFTED.  EXPLAINED HOW THE CREATION OF CITIES WOULD GRAVELY DIMINISH THEIR (IRA) AND REDUCE THE TERRITORIAL JURISDICTION OF EXISTING CITIES AND PROVINCES AND MENTIONED OTHER NEGATIVE EFFECTS OF SUCH CREATION.  CITED SEVERAL PROPOSALS AND POINTED OUT THEIR NON-COMPLIANCE WITH THE FUNDAMENTAL GUIDELINES ON THE CREATION OF NEW CITIES.  PROPOSED FOR A CREATION OF A SPECIAL OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE TO INVESTIGATE THE ANOMALY SO THAT PROPER ACTION WILL BE DONE TO STAVE OFF THE HEMORRHAGINGOF THE EXISTING CITIES AND PROVINCES THAT HAVE BEEN AND WILL BE VICTIMIZED BY THIS MOVE IN UTTER VIOLATION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL MANDATE.
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Rep. Javier.  Suspended.

rows.author: D007
rows.abstract: URGED THE HOUSE TO ACT ON RECENT DEVELOPMENTS REGARDING THE AFFAIR OF RODOLFO NOEL LOZADA, JR., FORMER PRESIDENT OF THE STATE-OWNED PHILIPPINE FOREST CORPORATION WHO WAS SUMMONED TO TESTIFY IN A SENATE INQUIRY INTO THE ABORTED S329-MILLION NATIONAL BROADBAND NETWORK PROJECT.  NARRATED THE TRAVAILS SUFFERED BY LOZADA AND HOW THE TWIST OF EVENTS RELEASED HIM FROM HIS ABDUCTORS.  STATED THAT THIS INCIDENT SPEAK OF THE EXTENT THE ADMINISTRATION WILL GO TO PROTECT ITSELF AND HOW IT IS READY TO SET ASIDE THE MOST BASIC HUMAN RIGHTS TO COVER UP CRIMINAL ACTIVITIES INCLUDING PLUNDER TO STAY IN POWER.  IT ALSO ATTESTS HOW LOW THE HIGHEST OFFICIAL OF THE LAND WILL GO TO STIFLE THE TESTIMONY THAT WILL INFLICT DAMAGE TO THE ADMINISTRATION'S SCANDAL-RIDDEN S329-MILLION NBN DEAL.  PRESENTED AND EXPLAINED IN DETAIL THE DIFFERENT CRIMES THAT WERE COMMITTED AND CITED SEVERAL LAWS THAT WERE VIOLATED.  DECLARED IT INCUMBENT FOR THE HOUSE TO CONDUCT ITS OWN INVESTIGATION NOT ONLY IN THE MATTER OF CONTRACTS, WHICH ULTIMATELY THE GOVERNMENT WILL PAY, BUT ALSO TO INVESTIGATE FOR LEGISLATION TO BE ABLE TO STOP THE ABDUCTION, THE OBSTRUCTION OF JUSTICE, THE WIRE TAPPING, THE GRAVE THREAT AND THE GRAVE COERCION COMMITTED ON A CIIZEN OF THIS REPUBLIC.  URGED THAT THE COMMITTEE ON GOOD GOVERNMENT REACTIVATES ITS INVESTIGATION ON THE NBN-ZTE DEAL.
rows.remarks: Rep. Biazon requested that his privilege speech be inserted into the records of the House for that day's session.

rows.author: D035
rows.abstract: TALKED ABOUT TRAFFICKING AS MORE THAN A WOMEN'S ISSUE; AS ONE OF THE MANY FORMS OF VIOLENCE; HAS BECOME GLOBAL BUSINESS THAT AFFECTS ALL COUNTRIES AND REAPS ENORMOUS PROFITS FOR TRAFFICKERS AND AS A SLAVERY LIKE PRACTICE THAT MUST BE ELIMINATED.  ADDED THAT TRAFFICKING CONSISTS PRIMARILY OF THE MOVEMENT OF PEOPLE FROM ONE COUNTRY TO ANOTHER FOR THE PURPOSE OF FORCED LABOR AND SEXUAL EXPLOITATION AND THAT IT IS ONE OF THE MOST IRRESISTIBLE ILLEGAL TRADES AND FASTEST GROWING CRIMES IN THE WORLD. EXPRESSED SENTIMENTS THAT IN THE 21ST CENTURY, THERE ARE PEOPLE WHO ARE FORCING INNOCENT WOMEN AND CHILDREN INTO A LIFE OF PROSTITUTION , ABUSE AND HUMILIATION AND THAT A SOCIETY CAN TOLERATE CRIMINALS WHO DESTROY LIVES AND TREAT HUMANS LIKE COMMODITY IN ORDER TO MAKE PROFIT. CITED CASES OF YOUNG FILIPINO WOMEN BEING TRAFFICKED FOR SEXUAL EXPLOITATION DRAWN BY THE ADVENTURE OF WORK ABROAD ON THE FALSE PROMISE OF A HIGH-PAYING DECENT JOB.  ALARMED BY THE RISING TREND OF THIS OBVIOUS LARGE SCALE PROBLEM WHICH HAS BECOME A MAJOR CONCERN FOR GOVERNMENTS, NGOs AND MEDIA.  STATED THAT ACCORDING TO A U.S. ANNUAL REPORT, THE PHILIPPINES REMAINS A SOURCE, TRANSIT AND DESTINATION COUNTRY FOR HUMAN TRAFFICKING.  NOTED SIGNIFICANT PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9208 - THE \"ANTI-TRAFFICKING IN PERSONS ACT OF 2003\"  EXPRESSED CONCERNS THAT INSPITE OF THE INITIATIVES BY THE GOVERNMENT AND OTHER SECTORS, TRAFFICKING IS STILL RAMPANT.  STATED THE NEED TO CREATE SUFFICIENT JOBS AND GREATER OPPORTUNITIES FOR WOMEN TO HELP AUGMENT FAMILY NEEDS AND OTHER ISSUES TO BE GIVEN ATTENTION TO END SEXUAL EXPLOITATION AND THE HUMAN TRAFFICKING OF WOMEN AND YOUNG GIRLS WHO OFTEN END UP IN THE SEX TRADE INDUSTRY.

rows.author: D085
rows.title_full: WOMEN AND POVERTY
rows.abstract: SALUTE THE STRUGGLES OF THE TOILING WOMEN WORLDWIDE IN CELEBRATION OF THE INTERNATIONAL WORKING WOMEN'S DAY.  LAMENTED THAT THE SITUATION OF THE FILIPINO WOMEN IS ALREADY REACHING AN ALL-TIME LOW AND THAT EXTREME POVERTY IS DOUBLY DIFFICULT FOR THE WOMAN WHO IS COMPELLED TO MUSTER ALL COPING MECHANISMS FOR HER FAMILY TO SURVIVE.  DISCUSSED ABOUT THE MISERY, HELPLESSNESS,INEQUALITIES AND DIFFICULTIES SUFFERED BY FILIPINO WORKING WOMEN.  DETAILED THE FLAWS COMMITTED BY THE ARROYO ADMINISTRATION WHICH WERE CLAIMED TO TAKE ITS HEAVY TOLLS ON POOR WOMEN.  ILLUSTRATED HOW POLITICKING, FOREIGN-ASSISTED LOAN PROJECTS, POVERTY AND CORRUPTION AFFECTED THE LIVES OF FILIPINO WOMEN.  URGES TO REVIVE THE OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE AND STRENGTHENS ITS ROLE IN ODA EVALUATION, PUTTING ON ITS AGENDA THE REVIEW OF THE POWERS OF THE NEDA AND REVIEW OF THE LAWS, ESPECIALLY THOSE THAT HAVE RELENTLESSLY LIBERALIZED THE ECONOMY, FOR THESE HAVE AGGRAVATED CONDITIONS OF POVERTY AND SOCIAL MISERY, AND PERPETUATED THE OPPRESSION OF OUR MARGINALIZED PEOPLE ESPECIALLY OUR POOR AND TOILING WOMEN.

rows.author: D053
rows.title_full: BIDDING SCAM IN THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION
rows.abstract: POINTED OUT SOME FACTORS WHICH CAUSED THE DETERIORATION OF OUR PHIL. EDUCATIONAL SYSTEM ONE OF WHICH IS THE FAULTY REFERENCE MATERIALS.  CITED GRAVE NEGLIGENCE OF THE DEPEDS OFFICIALS IN REVIEWING TEXTBOOKS AND TEACHER'S MANUAL, IN PULLING OUT BOOKS FOUND TO HAVE GLARING ERRORS; IN CLARIFYING IRREGULARITIES OF THE BIDDING IN THE PROCUREMENT AND IN GOING AFTER THE ERRING SUPPLIERS.  APPEALED STRONGLY THAT A FULL-BLOWN INVESTIGATION BE CONDUCTED TO THE END OF CRAFTING REMEDIAL MEASURES TO ENSURE THAT ERRING SUPPLIERS AND GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS WILL BE HELD ACCOUNTABLE AND PREVENT THE RECURRENCE OF SAUD IMPROPRIETIES.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-04-22
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Reps. Villanueva, Alfelor, Escudero, Padilla, Cerilles and Garin.  Manifestations by Reps. Ocampo, Hontiveros-Baraqueland Climaco.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: GROSS AND UNREASONABLE DELAY IN THE ISSUANCE OF MACHINE-READABLE PASSPORTS TO RESIDENTS OF MINDANAO
rows.abstract: GROSS AND UNREASONABLE DELAY IN THE ISSUANCE OF MACHINE-READABLE PASSPORTS OF ALL THE RESIDENTS OF MINDANAO.  COMPARED THE LENGTH OF TIME OF PROCESSING SAID PASSPORTS WITH THAT OF ORDINARY NONREADABLE PASSPORTS OR UNDER THE REGULAR SCHEME. NARRATED THE PROCEDURES FOR APPLICATION AND ISSUANCE AND SPECIFIED THE REASON FOR THE DELAY: THERE IS ONLY ONE PASSPORT PRODUCING MACHINE IN THE ENTIRE COUNTRY - IN PICC, MANILA.  STATED THAT SUCH DELAYS PREVENT THE CONSTITUENTS FROM MINDANAO FROM BEING ABLE TO BE IMMEDIATELY DEPLOYED AS NEEDED BY PRINCIPALS ABROAD THUS LOSING OUT TO THE FOREIGN WORKERS.  REQUIRES THE NEC(JAPANESE CORPORATION) TO IMMEDIATELY OPEN A UNIT IN CAGAYAN DE ORO TO HANDLE PASSPORT NEEDS OF THE ENTIRE MINDANAO.  PROPOSES LIKEWISE THAT ANOTHER BE INSTALLED IN WHICHEVER IS MORE EQUIDISTANT TO THE OTHER ISLANDS IN VISAYAS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on FOREIGN AFFAIRS since 2008-04-22
rows.remarks: Manifestation by Rep. Cerilles.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.abstract: WORSENING CONDITION OF TRADE UNION REPRESSION AND VIOLATIONS OF WORKERS' RIGHTS.  NARRATED SEVERAL INCIDENTS OF HARASSMENTS AND KILLINGS OF LABOR PROTESTERS. rows.author: D041
rows.title_full: REACTION TO NEWSPAPER ARTICLE QUOTING PHILIPPINE NAVY VICE COMMANDER REAR ADMIRAL AMABLE TOLENTINO AS SAYING THAT THE PHILIPPINE MILITARY IS INFERIOR TO MILITARY OF OTHER COUNTRIES
rows.title_short: IRRESPONSIBLE STATEMENT OF A RANKING PHILIPPINE NAVY OFFICER
rows.abstract: OPPOSED NAVY VICE COMMANDER, REAR ADMIRAL AMABLE TOLENTINO'S ADMISSION THAT THE PHIL. MILITARY IS INFERIOR TO THAT OF OTHER COUNTRIES.  OBJECTED TO HIS REMARKS THAT DIPLOMACY OR DIALOGUE IS BETTER THAN GOING TO WAR OR COMBAT.  QUESTIONED HIS EXPRESSING A CIVILIAN OPINION SINCE HE IS STILL SERVING THE ARMED FORCES.  COMMENTED ON THE ISSUE OF THE FIGHT OVER THE SPRATLYS WHEREIN THE MILITARY IS SUPPORTING THE WIN-WIN SITUATION.  DECLARED THAT THE MILITARY MUST BE PREPARED TO FIGHT WHATEVER THE ODDS OF VICTORY AND EVEN THE CERTAINTY OF DEFEAT WHEN THE TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY OF THE REPUBLIC IS AT STAKE.  DECLARED FURTHER THAT THE DETERRENT VALUE OF SUCH A MILITARY WHICH ADMITS IT WILL LOSE BEFORE IT FIGHTS AND IT WOULD RATHER TALK INSTEAD OF FIGHT IS ZERO AS ITS ACTUAL FIGHTING CAPABILTY.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE AND SECURITY since 2008-04-22
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.abstract: SPOKE ON THE 1982 UNITED NATIONS CONVENTION ON THE LAW OF THE SEA(UNCLOS) WHICH ENABLED THE PHILIPPINES TO DENOTE MARITIME ZONES AND JURISDICTIONS OF SOVEREIGNTY.  LAMENTED THAT THESE BOUNTIES CANNOT BE FULLY TAP BECAUSE IT HAS YET TO IMPLEMENT A CRUCIAL PROVISION OF THE UNCLOS.  POINTED OUT THAT THE COUNTRY MUST COMPLY WITH THE UN ACCORD TO PLOT BASELINES CONSISTENT WITH THE LAW OF THE SEA.  CITED FOUR OPTIONS ON DRAWING THE BASELINES.  DISCLOSED THAT COMMITTEE ON FOREIGN AFFAIRS OPTED TO ENCOMPASS THE MAIN ARCHIPELAGO, THE SCARBOROUGH SHOAL AND THE KIG AS ONE, PUTTING TERRITORIAL UNITY AND NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY AS ITS ONLY CONSIDERATION.  INFORMED THE BODY OF HB3216 WITH KIG AND SCARBOROUGH FALLING WITHIN THE COUNTRY'S BASELINES BUT THE EXECUTIVE DEPARTMENT FORMALLY PROPOSED TO EXCLUDE SUCH AREAS AND TREAT THESE MERELY AS A \"REGIME OF ISLANDS.  RECOMMENDED SEVERAL COURSES OF ACTION AND URGED THE MEMBERS TO REMAIN STEADFAST IN THEIR DUTY AS THE HIGHEST POLICY-MAKING BODY OF THE COUNTRY.  INFORMED THE BODY THAT APPROVAL OF THE BILL WILL BE ACTED UPON AFTER THE MATTER IS FULLY DISCUSSED IN A LEGISLATIVE-EXECUTIVE DEVELOPMENT ADVISORY COUNCIL (LEDAC).
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Reps. Marcos, Alfelor, Locsin, Golez, Lagman and Rodriguez.  Manifestation by Rep. Abante.  Suspended consideration.

POINTED OUT SEVERAL BENEFITS OF THE NEWLY LAUNCHED EXPRESSWAY IN URBAN AREAS OF METRO MANILA AND TO THE HUNDREDS OF MOTORISTS WHO PLY THE MACARTHUR HIGHWAY ROUTE EACH DAY; CREATES VAST OPPORTUNITIES FOR INVESTMENT, EMPLOYMENT AND DEVELOPMENT AND USHERS IN A NEW ERA OF SECURITY OPPORTUNITY AND PROSPERITY. rows.author: D095
rows.abstract: FOCUSED ON THE PROBLEMS AND ISSUES AND THE POSSIBLE SOLUTIONS TO THE RICE CRISIS.  POINTED OUT THAT THE CRISIS IF FOR REAL AND IS NOT DESIGNED TO DIVERT THE NATIONAL ATTENTION FROM THE ZTE SCANDAL.  DISCLOSED HOW THE RICE SHORTAGE WHICH IS CONSIDERED AS A GLOBAL CURSE HAS SOMEHOW MAGNIFIED THE SHORTAGES IN OTHER FOOD COMMODITIES.  UNDERSCORED THE SPECTACLE OF PEOPLE LINING UP TO BUY RICE IN ONE OF THE WORLD'S SUPPOSEDLY MOST EFFICIENT RICE PRODUCER.  POINTED OUT THAT THE PRESENT SOLUTIONS TO THE PROBLEM DO NOT INVOLVE COMPLEX EQUATIONS AS IT ONLY NEEDS THE GOVERNMENT TO MUSTER THE POLITICAL WILL TO CONFRONT THE CRISIS.  CLAIMED THAT THE \"FINAL SOLUTION\" TO ADDRESS THE MATTER OF CONTINUED RICE IMPORTATION AND RICE SHORTAGES IS THE IMPLEMENTATION OF A COMPREHENSIVE GOVERNMENT SUPERVISED RICE PRODUCTION PROGRAM.  ENUMERATED THE PROPOSAL OF THE BUTIL FARMERS PARTY, INCLUDING OTHER REFORMS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE & FOOD since 2008-04-21
rows.remarks: Referred to the Committee on Agriculture and Food.

rows.author: D045
rows.title_short: DEPARTURE AREA OF PUERTO PRINCESA AIRPORT
rows.abstract: INITIALLY SPOKE ABOUT THE NATURAL WONDERS OF THE PROVINCE OF PALAWAN SUCH AS PUERTO PRINCESA, UNDERGROUND RIVER AND THE TUBBATAHA REEFS WHICH BOTH MADE IT AS UNESCO'S NATURAL HERITAGE SITES.  CLAIMED THAT THE PALAWENOS HAVE EXPRESSED GRAVE CONCERN ABOUT THE PUERTO PRINCESA AIRPORT WHICH HAS BEEN NOTORIOUSLY CALLED AS \"OVEN-HOT KILLER TERMINAL\" BECAUSE OF THE NUMEROUS DEATHS OF PASSENGERS AND TOURISTS RESULTING FROM HEAT STROKE.  EXPRESSED HOPE THAT THE DOTC AND THE ATO WOULD IMMEDIATELY ADDRESS THE PROBLEM BY UPGRADING THE AIRPORT;  UNDERSCORED THAT THE PRESIDENT IS VERY MUCH AWARE OF THE BENEFITS OF UPGRADING SUCH TO AN INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT WHEREIN SHE HAD GIVEN THE MARCHING ORDERS TO THE DOTC TO IMPLEMENT THE PROJECT.  SOUGHT THE RELEASE OF FUNDING FOR THE CONSTRUCTION MORE PARTICULARLY ITS AIRCONDITIONING SYSTEM.

rows.author: E017
rows.abstract: FOCUSED ON THE PLIGHT OF FARMERS IN CALATAGAN, BATANGAS WHO ARE FACING EVICTION FROM THE AGRICULTURAL LANDS THAT THEY HAVE BEEN TILLING FOR A LONG TIME.  CLARIFIED THAT IT INVOLVES A PREVIOUSLY OWNED LAND THAT WERE DISTRIBUTED THROUGH EMANCIPATION PATENTS GIVEN TO AGRARIAN REFORM BENEFICIARIES.  DISCLOSED THAT AFTER THE FARMERS HAD PAID THE LANDS, THE HEIRS OF THE FORMER OWNER THEREOF ILLEGALLY SOLD THE PROPERTY TO A MINING COMPANY, ASTURIAS INDUSTRIES.  THUS A LEGAL CAMPAIGN WAGED AGAINST THE FARMERS BY THE MINING FIRM IN COLLUSION WITH THE FORMER LANDOWNERS AND GOVERNMENT AGENCIES HAS ENSUED, WITH DAR SUSTAINING THE PROTEST BY THE FIRM.  STATED THAT PARTY-LIST AKBAYAN JOINS THE FILIPINO FARMERS IN ENSURING THAT LANDS WOULD BE GIVEN TO LANDLESS FARMERS AND TO ADDRESS LOOPHOLES IN THE LAW.  STATED THAT A SUBSTITUTE BILL EXTENDING AND REFORMING THE CARP SHOULD MERIT THE SUPPORT AND APPROVAL OF THE BODY, BUT THIS SHOULD INCLUDE THE PROHIBITION ON LAND CONVERSION OF IRRGABLE AND IRRIGATED LANDS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on RULES since 2008-04-23
rows.remarks: Manifestation by Rep. Escudero.  Referred to the Committee on Rules.

rows.author: F095
rows.title_full: SMUGGLING OF AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS
rows.abstract: STRESSED THAT MASSIVE OUTRIGHT AND TECHNICAL SMUGGLING OF PORK, POULTRY MEAT, FISH, VEGETABLES, RICE, SUGAR AND FLOUR, GIVES UNFAIR COMPETITION TO FILIPINO FARMERS, THREATENS FOOD SECURITY, ENDANGERS PUBLIC HEALTH, AND DEPRIVES THE GOVERNMENT OF HUNDREDS OF BILLIONS OF PESOS IN TAXES.  PROPOSED A REVAMP IN THE BUREAU OF CUSTOMS AND CHECK THE EFFECTIVENESS OF ITS COMMISSIONERS AND GIVE INCENTIVES TO TIPSTERS WHO GIVE INFORMATION ON SMUGGLERS.  SUGGESTED THE IMMEDIATE CONVENING OF THE CONGRESSIONAL OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE FOR CUSTOMS TO MONITOR THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE LAW ON THE PHYSICAL EXAMINATION OF CARGOES AND THE PASSING OF ANTI-SMUGGLING BILLS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE & FOOD since 2008-05-20
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Reps. Alfelor, Mendoza, Sandoval and Mitra. Remarks of Rep. Padilla and manifestation of Rep. Estrella (R.).  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: E017
rows.title_full: ABUSIVE HIGH SCHOOL PRINCIPAL AND TEACHERS OF SAUYO HIGH SCHOOL IN NOVALICHES
rows.abstract: SPOKE ON THE COMPLAINTS RAISED BY THE STUDENTS OF SAUYO HIGH SCHOOL AGAINST AN ABUSIVE TEACHER AND THE MISUSE OF STUDENTS FUNDS BY THE GENERAL PARENTS, TEACHERS, AND COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION (GPTCA).  BROUGHT TO THE ATTENTION OF THE BODY THE CONTINUING COLLECTION OF MISCELLANEOUS FEES DURING ENROLLMENT PERIOD, THE MATTER OF THE PTA'S MANAGEMENT OF FUNDS COLLECTED FROM THE STUDENTS, AND THE EXISTING POLICIES GOVERNING THE ABUSES MADE BY THE TEACHERS AND HOW THEY ARE BEING IMPLEMENTED.  CALLED THE ATTENTION OF THE MEMBERS TO ADDRESS THE PLIGHT OF THE STUDENTS, PARENTS AND TEACHERS OF SAUYO HIGH SCHOOL.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-05-20
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Rep. Escudero.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: F086
rows.title_full: ALLEGED \"GANG OF FOUR\" IN THE BUREAU OF IMMIGRATION
rows.abstract: TOOK THE FLOOR TO WITHDRAW HIS SPONSORSHIP OF HOUSE BILLS NOS. 2408 AND 2409 ENHANCING THE REVENUE-GENERATING POTENTIALS OF THE BUREAU OF IMMIGRATION IN VIEW OF THE EXTORTION ACTIVITIES OF THE SO-CALLED \"GANG OF FOUR\" WITHIN THE BUREAU.  ENUMERATED WHAT HE CLAIMED AS ADVERSE EFFECTS OF THE CONTINUED ACTIVITIES OF THE GROUP.  STATED THAT THE ANTICORRUPTION DRIVE OF THE GOVERNMENT WILL BE SERIOUSLY BLEMISHED AND CAN EVEN DAMAGE THE REPUTATION OF THE PRESENT ADMINISTRATION.  STATED THAT IT IS HIS CONSTITUTIONAL RIGHT TO PROTECT THE INTEREST OF HIS PEOPLE FROM CERTAIN PEOPLE SUCH AS THE \"GANG OF FOUR\" IN THE BUREAU OF IMMIGRATION.  ASKED HIS COLLEAGUES TO SUPPORT ANY INVESTIGATION AND INQUIRY BY THE HOUSE IN THE FUTURE REGARDING THE ISSUE.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOOD GOVERNMENT AND PUBLIC ACCOUNTABILITY since 2008-05-20
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Reps. Coquilla, Rodriguez, Padilla, Bichara, Lagman and Datumanong.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: E062
rows.mother_status: Adopted as Resolution No. HR00201 on 2008-10-07
rows.title_full: \"GHOST DELIVERY\" OF POWER AND OVERPRICING OF ELECTRICITY BY MERALCO
rows.abstract: EMPHASIZED THE NEED FOR CLARITY IN DISCUSSING THE COST OF ELECTRICITY AND THE CHARGES THAT GO WITH IT, ALONG WITH HIGHLY TECHNICAL TERMS AND FORMULAS.  NOTED THAT THE PROBLEM HAS BEEN AGGRAVATED BY PARTISAN ACCUSATIONS OF EITHER \"POLITICAL SQUEEZE PLAY OR A PLAN OF GOVERNMENT TAKEOVER OF A PUBLIC UTILITY.  SAID THAT IT WAS ONLY UNTIL CONGRESS, THROUGH THE JOINT CONGRESSIONAL POWER COMMISSION AND THE COMMITTEE ON ENERGY, THAT A GLIMMER OF LIGHT SHONE WHEN IT CONDUCTED PUBLIC HEARINGS ON THE CONTROVERSY.  ALLEGED THAT THIS ALL EMANATED FROM THE DEAL BETWEEN THE LOPEZ-OWNED FIRST GAS AND THE LOPEZ-MANAGED AND CONTROLLED MERALCO.  EXPLAINED THAT THIS DEAL HAS RESULTED IN A BLATANT OVERCHARGING OF CONSUMERS.
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Rep. Bagatsing.  Suspended.

rows.author: E042
rows.title_full: ELECTION PROTESTS FILED AGAINST BARANGAY OFFICIALS WHO WON IN THE 2007 BARANGAY ELECTIONS
rows.abstract: DESCRIBED THE CONDUCT OF BARANGAY ELECTIONS IN CALOOCAN CITY THE PREVIOUS YEAR AS AMONG THE MOST HEAVILY GUARDED CONTESTS IN THE CITY'S HISTORY.  NOTED THAT EVEN IF THE CASES INVOLVED SEPARATE PERSONALITIES AND BARANGAYS, THE ALLEGATIONS OF FRAUD AND IRREGULARITIES FOUND IN THE COMPLAINTS WERE PRACTICALLY THE SAME.  DISCUSSED CERTAIN INSTANCES IN THE PREVIOUS BARANGAY ELECTIONS IN CALOOCAN CITY WHICH HIGHLIGHTED THE NEED FOR CONGRESS TO UNDERTAKE COURSES OF ACTION.  UNDERSCORED THAT IT IS THE DUTY OF MEMBERS OF CONGRESS TO PRESERVE THE SANCTITY OF THE BALLOT AND TO INCREASE THE PEOPLE'S CONFIDENCE IN THE ELECTIONS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2008-05-20
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: D013
rows.title_full: INCLUSION OF SEVERAL PHILIPPINE TOURIST SPOTS IN THE LIST OF NOMINEES FOR THE NEW SEVEN WONDERS OF THE WORLD
rows.abstract: SPOKE ABOUT THE NEED TO PROMOTE PHILIPPINE TOURISM BECAUSE OF ITS POTENTIAL POSITIVE CONTRIBUTIONS TO ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND IMPROVED QUALITY OF LIFE.  DISCUSSED HOW THE PEOPLE COULD HELP DEVELOP DOMESTIC TOURISM USING MODERN TECHNOLOGY, SPECIFICALLY ENCOURAGED EVERYONE TO REGISTER AND VOTE ONLINE FOR THE INCLUSION OF THE TUBBATAHA REEF IN PALAWAN, THE CHOCOLATE HILLS OF BOHOL AND THE UNDERGROUND RIVER OF PUERTO PRINCESA IN PALAWAN INTO THE \"NEW SEVEN WONDERS OF NATURE.\"  INFORMED THE BODY THAT HE HAD FILED A RESOLUTION URGING CONGRESS AND ALL GOVERNMENT AGENCIES TO LAUNCH CAMPAIGN PROGRAMS IN SUPPORT OF THE COUNTRY'S BID.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TOURISM since 2008-05-20
rows.remarks: Interpellated by Rep. Apostol.  Referred to the appropriate committee.

rows.author: D084
rows.abstract: TALKED ABOUT THE FOOD CRISIS, POVERTY AND AGRARIAN PROGRAM BROUGHT ABOUT BY IMPROPER IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROGRAMS OF PAST THROUGH PRESENT ADMINISTRATION.  POINTED OUT THAT EXPORT ORIENTED PRODUCTION WAS GIVEN PRIORITY RATHER THAN AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION.  STRESSED THAT THE COUNTRY BECAME IMPORT-DEPENDENT ON AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS BECAUSE OF GLOBALIZATION AND IMPORT LIBERALIZATION.  STATED THAT CARP HAS ALSO CONTRIBUTED TO THE DETERIORATION OF THE AGRICULTRUAL SECTOR BECAUSE OF ITS \"MARKET-ORIENTED LAND REFORM\".  POINTED OUT THAT THE COUNTRY'S FOOD SECURITY SHOULD FOCUS ON HOW TO MAKE THE AGRICULTURAL SECTOR STRONG AND HEALTHY.
rows.remarks: Referred to the appropriate committee.
